title: 98. Quantitative Relationships & Measurement: Comparing Unit Prices
description: A comprehensive mathematics curriculum progressing from foundational numeracy and core mathematical concepts to algebra, geometry, calculus, linear algebra, probability, statistics, discrete mathematics, optimization, mathematical foundations of AI, advanced pure mathematics, and emerging research methods.

questions.concept: Comparing Unit Prices of Two Packages
questions.learningObjective: Determine which package has the lower unit price.
questions.question: Package P contains \(4\) pens and costs \(5\text{ USD}\). Package Q contains \(6\) pens and costs \(9\text{ USD}\). Which package has the lower unit price?
questions.explanation: The unit price of Package P is \(5 \div 4 = 1.25\) dollars per pen. The unit price of Package Q is \(9 \div 6 = 1.50\) dollars per pen. Since \(1.25 < 1.50\), Package P has the lower unit price.
questions.hint: Divide the total price of each package by the number of items in it.

questions.concept: Comparing Unit Prices of Rice Packages
questions.learningObjective: Determine which rice package has the lower price per kilogram.
questions.question: Package P: \(3\text{ kg}\) of rice for \(12\text{ USD}\). Package Q: \(5\text{ kg}\) of rice for \(25\text{ USD}\). Which package has the lower unit price?
questions.explanation: The unit price of Package P is \(12 \div 3 = 4\) dollars per kilogram. The unit price of Package Q is \(25 \div 5 = 5\) dollars per kilogram. Since \(4 < 5\), Package P has the lower unit price.
questions.hint: Find the cost of one kilogram for each package.

questions.concept: Comparing Unit Prices of Juice Containers
questions.learningObjective: Determine which juice container has the lower price per litre.
questions.question: Container P: \(2\text{ L}\) of juice for \(6\text{ USD}\). Container Q: \(3\text{ L}\) of juice for \(7.50\text{ USD}\). Which container has the lower unit price?
questions.explanation: The unit price of Container P is \(6 \div 2 = 3\) dollars per litre. The unit price of Container Q is \(7.50 \div 3 = 2.50\) dollars per litre. Since \(2.50 < 3\), Container Q has the lower unit price.
questions.hint: Divide the price by the number of litres in each container.

questions.concept: Comparing Unit Prices with Different Masses
questions.learningObjective: Determine which cheese package has the lower price per 100 grams.
questions.question: Package P: \(500\text{ g}\) of cheese for \(8\text{ USD}\). Package Q: \(750\text{ g}\) of cheese for \(10.50\text{ USD}\). Which package has the lower unit price?
questions.explanation: For Package P, the price per gram is \(8 \div 500 = 0.016\) dollars, so the price per \(100\text{ g}\) is \(1.60\text{ USD}\). For Package Q, the price per gram is \(10.50 \div 750 = 0.014\) dollars, so the price per \(100\text{ g}\) is \(1.40\text{ USD}\). Since \(1.40 < 1.60\), Package Q has the lower unit price.
questions.hint: Convert each price to a cost per \(100\text{ g}\), then compare.

questions.learningObjective: Determine which package of rolls has the lower price per roll.
questions.question: Package P: \(12\) rolls for \(9\text{ USD}\). Package Q: \(8\) rolls for \(6.40\text{ USD}\). Which package has the lower unit price?
questions.explanation: The unit price of Package P is \(9 \div 12 = 0.75\) dollars per roll. The unit price of Package Q is \(6.40 \div 8 = 0.80\) dollars per roll. Since \(0.75 < 0.80\), Package P has the lower unit price.
questions.hint: Divide the total price by the number of rolls in each package.

questions.learningObjective: Determine which bag of apples has the lower price per kilogram.
questions.question: Bag P: \(1.5\text{ kg}\) of apples for \(4.50\text{ USD}\). Bag Q: \(2\text{ kg}\) of apples for \(5.60\text{ USD}\). Which bag has the lower unit price?
questions.explanation: The unit price of Bag P is \(4.50 \div 1.5 = 3.00\) dollars per kilogram. The unit price of Bag Q is \(5.60 \div 2 = 2.80\) dollars per kilogram. Since \(2.80 < 3.00\), Bag Q has the lower unit price.
questions.hint: Divide the price of each bag by its mass in kilograms.

questions.learningObjective: Determine which pack of bottles has the lower price per bottle.
questions.question: Pack P: \(6\) bottles for \(7.20\text{ USD}\). Pack Q: \(10\) bottles for \(11.00\text{ USD}\). Which pack has the lower unit price?
questions.explanation: The unit price of Pack P is \(7.20 \div 6 = 1.20\) dollars per bottle. The unit price of Pack Q is \(11.00 \div 10 = 1.10\) dollars per bottle. Since \(1.10 < 1.20\), Pack Q has the lower unit price.
questions.hint: Find the price of one bottle in each pack.

questions.concept: Comparing Unit Prices of Tea Packages
questions.learningObjective: Determine which tea package has the lower price per kilogram.
questions.question: Package P: \(250\text{ g}\) of tea for \(10\text{ USD}\). Package Q: \(400\text{ g}\) of tea for \(16.40\text{ USD}\). Which package has the lower unit price?
questions.explanation: Package P contains \(0.25\text{ kg}\), so its unit price is \(10 \div 0.25 = 40\) dollars per kilogram. Package Q contains \(0.4\text{ kg}\), so its unit price is \(16.40 \div 0.4 = 41\) dollars per kilogram. Since \(40 < 41\), Package P has the lower unit price.
questions.hint: Convert grams to kilograms before calculating the price per kilogram.

questions.concept: Comparing Unit Prices of Bulk Packs
questions.learningObjective: Determine which bulk pack has the lower price per item.
questions.question: Pack P: \(24\) items for \(18\text{ USD}\). Pack Q: \(36\) items for \(25.20\text{ USD}\). Which pack has the lower unit price?
questions.explanation: The unit price of Pack P is \(18 \div 24 = 0.75\) dollars per item. The unit price of Pack Q is \(25.20 \div 36 = 0.70\) dollars per item. Since \(0.70 < 0.75\), Pack Q has the lower unit price.
questions.hint: Divide the total price by the number of items in each pack.

questions.concept: Comparing Unit Prices of Flour Packages
questions.learningObjective: Determine which flour package has the lower price per kilogram.
questions.question: Package P: \(1.5\text{ kg}\) of flour for \(9.75\text{ USD}\). Package Q: \(2.5\text{ kg}\) of flour for \(16.50\text{ USD}\). Which package has the lower unit price?
questions.explanation: The unit price of Package P is \(9.75 \div 1.5 = 6.50\) dollars per kilogram. The unit price of Package Q is \(16.50 \div 2.5 = 6.60\) dollars per kilogram. Since \(6.50 < 6.60\), Package P has the lower unit price.
questions.hint: Calculate the price per kilogram for each package and compare the results.
